provenance.method: Questions were written from domain questions rather than copied page titles. Accepted pages were selected by reading page summaries and section structure; search output was used only to discover candidates, not as acceptance evidence.
provenance.review_note: No independent adjudication exists. Treat hit rates as author-labelled diagnostics until a separate reviewer adjudicates the set.
